instructions.question: What overall feeling does the tweet's author clearly express about its topic: positive, neutral, or negative?
instructions.rule: Give positive or negative only when the author shows a clear feeling; when unsure, choose neutral. Mild critique, analysis, banter, sarcastic jokes among fans, sports commentary and small everyday gripes are neutral. Plans and activities stated without explicit enthusiasm are neutral, but upbeat promotion of events or products, and tributes to the dead, are positive. Real anger, insults, distress, or reports of violent attacks and killings are negative.

neutral.what: News, announcements, plans, questions, opinions and commentary without strong emotion, including mild criticism, jokes, sarcasm-as-banter and small gripes.
examples: Fake punt on 4th and 11? Wow, James Franklin can make some odd decisions. #PennState #Michigan #PSUvsMICH
Going to see Paper Towns on Saturday. I'm hoping it does the book justice.
What will happen to the clemency plea before the President? SC says Yakub can be executed on Thursday.
Kanye West is insane. He also may be a complete genius. But I still don't want him to be president. #VMAs #fb
neutral.cues: may, will be, going to, who wants to, tomorrow, lol, wow, reportedly, headlines, sports scores
neutral.not_for: Clear rage, insults or distress (negative); explicit delight or promotional hype (positive).

positive.what: Explicit excitement, praise, love, gratitude, celebration, warm tributes, or upbeat promotion of an event, product or team.
examples: Can't wait to see you tomorrow at The Roxy!
Celebrating the memories of a man who graced us with his knowledge and passion for the game every Monday night #RIP Frank Gifford. #Pro #NFL
Sat watching the sun set with a large glass of wine and a pack of marlies listening to fleetwood mac, DOES LIFE GET BETTER?? no, it does not
positive.cues: can't wait, excited, love, best, good, happy, thank you, fantastic, kick-off, celebrating, looking good, !!
positive.not_for: Plans or activities stated flatly, like going to a film or concert or asking who wants to come (neutral).

negative.what: Clear anger, hatred, insults, sadness, frustration or dread, or reports of violent attacks and killings.
examples: still so sad I'm not going to Ed Sheeran the 25th :////
Kanye West may in fact be the biggest douche bag in the history of the universe
Four were killed,19 injured when a IRA bomb demolished the Balmoral Furniture Building
negative.cues: hate, sad, FML, worst, bullshit, wtf, pathetic, killed, :(, :/, awkward, protest
negative.not_for: Analytical or joking criticism, sports second-guessing, trivial complaints about one's evening (neutral).
